models.observations: The tied ridge and broad reed skirt make the single hut legible at 40 px. At 80 px the light thatch at the peak separates from the olive skirt. The rain jar, rolled mat and solar clasp read at full size. The stairs meet the raised deck squarely. Serialized LODs are 516/274/136 triangles.
defects: At LOD0 and LOD1, each front corner post has an outer X face coplanar with the main wall side for 0.014 tile behind the wall’s front edge. Move the post inward or outward far enough to give the two visible planes distinct X coordinates.

At LOD0 and LOD1 the last tread ends at Z = -0.352 while the deck top starts at -0.353. Both exposed tops are at the same height across that 0.001-tile overlap. Terminate the upper tread at the deck edge or give the joint a small height step.
